description:
Replace MessageLog with SessionManager as the history store in Session.State,
and add new fields needed for compaction and extensions.

## Changes to apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session/state.ex

Remove:
  alias OctoPi.Agent.MessageLog
  messages: MessageLog.t() field (and its default %MessageLog{})

Add:
  alias OctoPi.Agent.SessionManager
  session_manager: SessionManager.t()    default SessionManager.new()
  is_compacting?: boolean()              default false
  overflow_recovery_attempted?: boolean() default false
  compaction_abort_ref: AbortRef.t() | nil default nil
  base_system_prompt: String.t() | nil   default nil
    (extensions can override the per-turn system prompt while preserving the base;
     nil means use system_prompt directly)
  tool_registry: %{String.t() => Tool.t()} default %{}
    (extensions and callers register tools here; active tool list in :tools is
     a filtered view of this registry)
  extension_runner: pid() | nil          default nil

## Changes to apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session.ex

Search for all references to state.messages (or the :messages key) and update:

APPEND a message:
  MessageLog.push(messages, msg) -> SessionManager.append_message(state.session_manager, msg)
  then: %{state | session_manager: updated_sm}

APPEND many messages:
  MessageLog.append_many(messages, list) -> sequential SessionManager.append_message calls
  (or add a SessionManager.append_messages/2 batch helper)

READ all messages for telemetry/history:
  MessageLog.to_list(messages) -> SessionManager.get_branch(state.session_manager)
  then extract .message from each MessageEntry

COUNT messages:
  MessageLog.count(messages) -> length(SessionManager.get_branch(state.session_manager))

The :run_complete cast from the Loop currently carries {messages :: MessageLog.t(), reason}.
Update the cast shape to {:run_complete, session_manager :: SessionManager.t(), reason}
and update the handle_cast clause in session.ex accordingly.
(The Loop itself will be updated in the sibling "Migrate Loop" ticket; for now this
ticket just updates the handler to accept the new shape.)

NOTE: This ticket intentionally does NOT update loop.ex. The codebase will not
fully compile until both this ticket and the "Migrate Loop" ticket land. Merge
them together or land them in the same PR.

## Tests

Run mix test apps/octo_pi_agent/ after both this and the Loop migration ticket.
Existing session tests should continue passing.
title: Migrate Session.State from MessageLog to SessionManager
